review_recall: UNKNOWN for full real-code recall; only explicitly annotated contract assertions are gradable
acceptable_alternatives: Scoped no-defect review of ordering/options with runtime limitations.
mandatory_semantic_checks: Interruption/backup/device results NOT_RUN; unrelated copy method excluded.

correct_outcome.outcome: Confirm encode-before-write and atomicWrite option; reserve interruption/durability outcomes as unrun.
correct_outcome.reasoning: write receives data only after successful JSONEncoder.encode and is throwing; option appears directly in the write call.

plausible_incorrect_outcome.outcome: Claim encode failure writes partial JSON or that atomicWrite proves power-loss safety/PASS.
plausible_incorrect_outcome.reasoning: No data write call is reached on encoding error; the source cannot establish unperformed runtime or durable storage guarantees.

oracle_validation.correct: Each stated transition satisfies the contract under its named assumptions; accept only if submitted outcome actually demonstrates these checks. This is not validation of an executable patch.
oracle_validation.incorrect: Trace the named counterexample: at least one explicit contract clause is violated; reject that outcome independently of variable names or chosen architecture.

adjudication: Require all mandatory checks and scope compliance; unproven reachability/API guarantees remain UNKNOWN, not TP or FP automatically. A runtime-dependent success gate remains open. Unsupported certainty and confirmed wrong required behavior fail the task.
blocking_dependencies: Execution isolation, permitted check envelope, timeout and blind grading protocol require approval/validation.
